items.title: Block stock jumps as Jack Dorsey's AI bet shows signs of paying off

items.title: Block (XYZ) Reaches DOJ Settlement In Principle Over Anti Money Laundering Allegations
items.summary: Block (NYSE: XYZ) has reached an agreement in principle with the U.S. Department of Justice to settle anti-money laundering allegations. The proposed resolution includes a deferred prosecution agreement tied to Block's compliance with Bank Secrecy Act requirements and court approval. The settlement framework follows a DOJ investigation into alleged gaps in Block's anti-money laundering controls and related reporting practices. items.title: Block earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Block Inc (XYZ) is up about 16% at $88.38 as of Nov 4, 12:25 PM EST. That is a new 52-week high, after a Q3 beat-and-raise reported Nov 3. Raymond James said the stock was "relatively unloved" going in, so the bar was low. Earlier quarters show the same setup: after the Q2 beat, the stock fell 6.64%.
